verdict.rationale: Poly has no documented export feature. Its files do appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer that syncs automatically, and journal entries are stored as plain Markdown files, so users could copy their data out with ordinary tools. The CLI can also read files from the terminal. Leaving is therefore implied by the storage model rather than offered as a supported export path. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of the full knowledge base, export of Poly-specific data (tags beyond Finder sync, Mind memory, version history, agent context) in open formats, and any hands-on confirmation that a complete exit is practical.
